modelingNotes: ZB4BW343 is the electrically passive MECHANICAL HEAD sub-assembly of a Harmony XB4 metal illuminated pushbutton: chromium-plated metal bezel, round, flush, red, plain lens, spring return, Ø22.5 mm, for universal-LED bodies. Datasheet 'Device presentation: Basic sub-assemblies'. It is not a complete pushbutton, contact block or light block.

Zero electrical terminals. No contacts, no LED, no light-block terminals, no supply/return/PE terminal. Catalog (10/2021) p.31 lists it under 'Heads only - With plain lens' with no NO/NC contact columns; contacts, the integral LED and all wiring terminals belong to a separately ordered body sub-assembly (e.g. ZB4BW0B45 in complete unit XB4BW34B5 = ZB4BW0B45 + ZB4BW343). No contacts/LED were imported from the complete-unit table into this head.

Bonding/attachment: the metal bezel mounts in a Ø22.5 mm panel cutout and snap-fits to a ZB4B body. No PE/bond terminal is documented on the head; any earth path through panel/collar/metalwork is an installation matter, not a manufacturer-documented terminal. Coverage is partial with zero documented terminals; no bonding path is asserted as manufacturer fact.
connectorPorts.MOUNT documents the mechanical head-to-body and panel interface only; it carries no electrical pins and manufactures no net continuity.

Source/expected order code 'ZB4-BW343' carries a presentation hyphen; the manufacturer datasheet and catalog spell it 'ZB4BW343' (no hyphen) for the identical product. Source descriptor 'Round countersunk head' reconciles to the manufacturer 'Round / Red flush'; no neighboring variant substituted.

No switching voltage/current rating is claimed for the head (it has no contacts). The datasheet 'Electrical composition code' (M1/M2/M6/M10) describes LED/contact positions of the assembled device, not terminals of this head.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical illuminated-pushbutton head; zero documented electrical terminals. Contacts, integral LED and wiring terminals belong to the separately ordered ZB4BW0... body sub-assembly and are out of scope. The metal-bezel bonding/attachment interface is undocumented at the head (installation-dependent); no PE terminal is asserted.
